chapters.title: Learning Is Misunderstood
chapters.sourcePressure: The opening chapter separates familiarity from learning: rereading, highlighting, cramming, and massed practice feel effective because recognition is doing the work, while retrieval, spacing, and interleaving create less flattering but more durable evidence.
chapters.coreMove: Replace the feeling of smooth review with a later proof of recall, transfer, and durable use.
chapters.commonMisread: The writer must avoid turning this into a general anti-comfort sermon; the chapter is about misreading fluency as mastery and choosing a better scorecard.

chapters.title: To Learn, Retrieve
chapters.sourcePressure: The chapter reframes testing and self-quizzing as retrieval practice: a low-stakes recall attempt strengthens access and exposes repair targets when it is followed by feedback.
chapters.coreMove: Turn recall into the learning event by making memory produce, checking the miss, repairing it, and retrieving again.
chapters.commonMisread: The writer must avoid treating retrieval as formal testing pressure; the mechanism is reconstruction with correction, not anxiety or grading.

chapters.title: Mix Up Your Practice
chapters.sourcePressure: The chapter attacks blocked repetition: one skill repeated in a row can look strong during practice while leaving the learner weak at selection, discrimination, and transfer.
chapters.coreMove: Design practice so the learner has to discriminate among similar cases and choose the right move before using it.
chapters.commonMisread: The writer must avoid praising variety for its own sake; the point is structured mixing that forces comparison and choice.

chapters.title: Embrace Difficulties
chapters.sourcePressure: This chapter defines desirable difficulty as challenge that strengthens learning, while excluding overload, random confusion, and errors that never get corrected.
chapters.coreMove: Audit a hard practice moment for the mechanism that makes it desirable: retrieval, generation, spacing, variation, correction, or recovery.
chapters.commonMisread: The writer must avoid saying hard is better; the chapter asks what the difficulty makes the learner do.

chapters.title: Avoid Illusions of Knowing
chapters.sourcePressure: The chapter focuses on calibration: familiarity, rereading, and fluent recognition inflate confidence unless learners use tests, explanations, delayed recall, and external feedback.
chapters.coreMove: Make confidence answer to a cue-free check before treating it as knowledge.
chapters.commonMisread: The writer must avoid making confidence the enemy; the problem is untested confidence that borrows support from visible cues.

chapters.title: Get Beyond Learning Styles
chapters.sourcePressure: The chapter rejects matching instruction to preferred learning styles while preserving real learner differences: prior knowledge, language fluency, structure building, and active processing matter.
chapters.coreMove: Choose representations and practice demands from the material, prior knowledge, and task, not from a learner’s preferred style label.
chapters.commonMisread: The writer must avoid one-size-fits-all teaching; the chapter replaces style labels with evidence about content fit and learner preparation.

chapters.title: Increase Your Abilities
chapters.sourcePressure: The chapter argues that ability is more expandable than fixed labels suggest, but it keeps improvement grounded in domain-specific practice, strategy, persistence, and feedback rather than broad brain-training promises.
chapters.coreMove: Treat ability as improvable within a domain by pairing belief, deliberate practice, feedback, and memory cues with the specific skill being built.
chapters.commonMisread: The writer must avoid empty growth-mindset optimism; ability expands through concrete strategies and repeated work in the thing being learned.

chapters.title: Make It Stick
chapters.sourcePressure: The synthesis chapter turns the separate principles into routines for students, lifelong learners, teachers, and trainers, with practical systems that return, mix, retrieve, explain, check, and repair.
chapters.coreMove: Assemble retrieval, spacing, interleaving, calibration, and repair into a weekly system that keeps learning honest over time.
chapters.commonMisread: The writer must avoid a bag of study tips; the chapter is about combining the moves into a repeatable learning architecture.
